Frozen animated-surface id map — every element that moves on the site maps to exactly one id; several live elements may share an id (every media figure shares MEDIA_PROGRESSIVE).

Each record in the translations node carries two fields: alt — one-sentence label (img alt / aria-label source). longdesc — the full description: element, animation name, behavior, triggers, tech stack and purpose — the text AI agents, SEO crawlers and assistive tech read.
